At the time of writing (April 2023) you can choose from 7, 10, 15, 18, 21 or 24 meals per week with a large variety of dietitian-designed meals. The aim of the meals on this plan is to support and maintain peak fitness. Weekly meals are customisable to individual dietary preferences and there is a feature to filter and exclude allergens.

All meals are fresh, not frozen and there is an integration with MyFitnessPal to track your macro intake throughout the day.

Nutrition Rundown

The MACROS Perform Plan includes a large variety of dietitian-approved meals all of which are macronutrient controlled. Portion sizes and macros vary depending on the chosen fitness goal and the macronutrient ratios are clearly marked on each meal. Meals are unprocessed and balanced and are a quick and easy way to support your health goals.

Flavour and texture can vary between meals upon reheating. Depending on your individual training routine and hunger levels, for some extra protein sprinkle meals with raw nuts and seeds or hemp seeds or add a side of dark leafy greens.

Check out our Nutritionist’s review of MACROS Ready-to-eat meals here.
macros-plant-based-plan:
MACROS Plant-Based Plan includes single-serve, 100% plant-based meals for an individual looking to follow a balanced plant-based diet. Meals feature plant proteins including non-GMO tofu & tempeh, nuts and seeds, chickpeas, beans etc. 

At the time of writing (April 2023) you can choose from 13 different 35og plant-based meals each week. There is an option to filter and customise meals further to suit your individual dietary preferences however this can limit the plan-based meals available. On the Plant-based Meal Plan, you can select  7, 10, 15, 18, 21 or 24 meals delivered per week.

Nutrition Rundown

The MACROS Plant-Based Plan includes dietitian-approved meals which are macronutrient controlled. Each macronutrient ratio is clearly stated for each meal along with ingredient lists and allergens present. MACROS use wholefood ingredients with limited preservatives and additives. 

When compared to other plans, meals feature a larger portion of carbohydrates and are packed full of different vegetables and flavours. This plan is a great way to transition and stick to a plant-based diet at home and takes the fuss out of meal prep and planning. 

Check out our Nutritionist’s review of MACROS Ready-to-eat meals here.
macros-sculpt-plan:
MACROS Sculpt Plan is one of the MACROS Fitness plan options and includes single-serve meals that are high in protein, and lower in carbs and calories with the aim to help fast-track the individual to lose weight and tone muscles. Each Sculpt meal serves one and is 300g.

At the time of writing (April 2023) you can choose from 7, 10, 15, 18, 21 or 24 meals per week. There is a large variety of meals that are all dietitian designed to help individuals get lean and defined. Similar to other MACROS plans, meals are customisable to your individual dietary preferences with options including plant-based, paleo, dairy-free etc. There is an extra feature to filter and exclude additional allergens.

There is also a great integration of MACROS meals with MyFitnessPal to easily track your macro intake throughout the day.

Nutrition Rundown

The MACROS Sculpt Plan includes dietitian-approved meals which are macronutrient controlled. This easily guides individuals towards the right portion sizes based on their own specific fitness goals. Macronutrient ratios are clearly outlined for each meal. It’s important to check the macronutrient ratios against individualised personal targets to ensure you are providing the body with what it needs.

There are 3 different fitness plans and the macronutrient ratio changes specific to the plan. This is a quick, easy and simple way to support your health goals. We love that the meals are fresh, not frozen.

Check out our Nutritionist’s review of MACROS Ready-to-eat meals here.
macros-vegetarian-meal-plan:
MACROS is a popular ready-made meal delivery service in Australia known for its nutritionist-designed, chef-prepared meals that cater to specific health goals and dietary preferences. Their Vegetarian Meal Plan is ideal for plant-based eaters looking to maintain a balanced diet while saving time on cooking and grocery shopping.

MACROS meals are fully prepared and delivered fresh, not frozen, making them a convenient option for busy professionals, families, or anyone following a vegetarian lifestyle.

The MACROS Vegetarian Plan features meat-free meals that are rich in wholefoods, legumes, grains, and plant-based proteins. Popular meals include dishes like Chilli Non Carne, Chickpea Coconut Curry, and Zesty Bean Nachos. The menu is small, with 6 options typically available at anytime.

You can choose a weekly subscription with options to receive 7, 10, 15, 18, 21, or 24 meals per week, depending on your needs and lifestyle. All meals are portion-controlled and macro-balanced to support energy, fullness, and nutrition.

Nutrition Rundown

MACROS’ vegetarian meals are:

  • High in plant-based protein
  • Low in saturated fats
  • Balanced with complex carbohydrates and fibre

Each meal comes with a clear nutritional label showing calories, protein, fats, carbs, and fibre. Meals generally range from 300–500 calories per serve and provide 15–25g of plant-based protein, ideal for active individuals and anyone looking to stay full and fuelled.

MACROS vegetarian meals cost $11.45. Delivery is available to most major cities and regional areas across Australia, with deliveries scheduled weekly and the flexibility to pause or cancel anytime.

Check out our Nutritionist’s review of MACROS Ready-to-eat meals here.
macros-weight-loss-plan:
MACROS Weight Loss Plan includes single-serve meals that are low in carbs and calories to help support an individual’s weight loss goals. Each of the weight loss meals is 300g and under 350 calories. 

At the time of writing (April 2023) you can choose 7, 10, 15, 18, 21 or 24 meals per week with a large variety and interesting meals on the menu. There are approximately 35+ meals below 350 calories with some of them classified as plant-based meals. Meals are easily customisable to suit dietary preferences and there is an additional feature to help filter additional allergens from meals.

Nutrition Rundown

The MACROS Weight Loss Plan offers macronutrient-controlled meals, made fresh to order. All meals on this plan are calorie-controlled and include a balance of macronutrients in each meal, with the ratios stated clearly on each meal. The protein portion is smaller when compared to other MACROS plans and mostly features vegetables and carbohydrates. Some meals taste a little bit bland and lack flavour. 

Tip: Try sprinkling raw nuts and seeds, hemp seeds or adding a small portion of hummus to increase the amount of protein in each meal.

Check out our Nutritionist’s review of MACROS Ready-to-eat meals here.
marley-spoon-dairy-free:

There are a great variety of recipes marked as dairy free and meals are macronutrient balanced – high fibre, low GI and include lean proteins and complex carbohydrates. The full ingredient list for each product used in the recipes is available.

marley-spoon-high-protein:

MarleySpoons Low-Carb meals aim to contain less than 25g of carbs/serve – essentially this would fit the criteria of a keto meal as long as you are tracking your carbohydrate intake throughout the day.

This is where the option of a Meal Kit is great compared to ready-to-eat meals as you have full control over the ingredients in your meals to meet your own individualised needs.

As a whole, we love MarleySpoon’s Meal Kits as they aim to include high fibre, low GI and lean proteins in each meal and generally exclude sources of refined or processed carbs.

marley-spoon-meal-kit:
Marley Spoon is all about convenience and inspiring people to cook recipes from scratch in 6 easy steps. They focus on high quality, locally sourced, pre-portioned ingredients for zero food waste and offer a large variety of meals compared to other meal delivery kits in Australia. 

At the time of writing (October 2023), Marley Spoon offers two plans: 2-person and 4-person. For each plan, you can choose from 2, 3, 4, or 5 meals per week. There are 70+ recipes each week to choose from (options change weekly), and the meal kits are easily customisable to individual dietary preferences.

Nutrition Rundown

Marley Spoon considers dietary/lifestyle requirements including vegan, low-calorie, healthy, fast, vegetarian, no-added gluten, dairy-free and family-friendly. There are a minimum of 8 vegetarian meals and 10 no-added gluten meals per week. The wide variety of recipes is great for picky eaters and individuals with strong dietary preferences or dietary restrictions. 

Research from the University of Sydney has analysed and compared the nutritional composition of some of Australia’s largest meal kit providers showing that MarleySpoon provides the highest amount of protein per meal and the lowest amount of fat per meal compared to other meal kit subscription services. This research suggests that MarleySpoon meal kits would be a suitable choice for individuals trying to lose weight or maintain weight. Individuals may choose to consider the low-calorie (250-550 calories/per serving) or reduced-carb recipes (less than 25g of carbs/per serving).

The meals are balanced and include high-fibre and low-GI ingredients and lean proteins. The sodium content of the meals is on the higher end so avoid adding additional salt to your meals. 

Tip: The meal portions are standard and fulfilling however if needed you can always choose to add a portion of leafy or steamed greens to increase nutrient and fibre intake at meal times.

musashi-plant-protein-powder:
Musashi offers a broad spectrum of sports nutrition supplements sourced from high-quality ingredients, with formulas to support everyone from the casual exerciser to an elite athlete. 

Musashi’s plant protein powders are a great option, for a number of reasons including:

  • They are a blend of chia, brown rice and pea protein
  • Each 32g serve contains 23g of protein
  • Available in Vanilla and Chocolate flavours
  • Vegan-friendly
  • Low carb
  • Contain digestive enzymes
  • Designed to support lean muscle building and muscle recovery
  • Affordable

At the time of writing (June 2024), Musashi offers nationwide shipping within 17 hours of ordering, and orders qualify for free delivery at $150.

Nutrition Rundown

Musashi’s plant protein blend of rice, chia and pea protein contains all 9 essential amino acids, a fantastic way to increase protein intake on a vegan diet.  The shakes are perfect to consume as part of an exercise routine 60-90 minutes before exercise or within 30 minutes after resistance training.

There are a number of reasons individuals may choose a plant-based protein powder supplement including:

  • Increasing satiety and feeling full
  • Increasing protein intake
  • Muscle building
  • Muscle recovery
  • Weight Loss
  • Ethics related to animal welfare

These powders can be a great option for vegans; however, if you’re concerned about a product being prepared in the same factory as animal products, or you have a serious dairy allergy, it may contain dairy traces and may not be the best fit for you. While it promotes chia in the blend, it’s only 0.5% so you’re unlikely to receive the fibre and omega-3 benefits known from chia seed consumption in such a low concentration.

my-baby-organics-baby-and-toddler-food:

My Baby Organics is a healthy and nutritious choice for babies and toddlers.

my-fitness-kitchn:
My Fitness Kitchn is an Australian meal delivery service committed to making healthy eating convenient and consistent, without compromising on taste or nutrition. Specialising in macro-balanced meals tailored to fitness goals, the brand supports muscle building, weight management, and overall wellness with meals that are dietitian-designed and chef-prepared.

My Fitness Kitchn offers a Starter Pack, perfect for fitness-focused eaters who want to kickstart their fitness journey, but are unsure on where to start. Each pack includes a selection of 5 of their most popular high-protein, ready-made meals, freshly prepared and delivered chilled to your door.

Each meal in the Starter Pack is built around high-quality proteins, smart carbs, and healthy fats making it ideal for gym-goers, busy professionals, or anyone tracking their macros. Depending on whether you choose between the Light, Regular and Bulk options, the typical nutritional profile per meal includes:

  • Calories: 350–800 kcal

  • Protein: 30–70g

  • Carbohydrates: Moderate to high, from sources like brown rice, sweet potato, and whole grains

  • Fat: Healthy fats from olive oil, nuts, and lean meats

  • Portion-controlled: Perfect for fat loss, lean muscle gain or maintenance

  • No added colours or preservatives

Example meals include:

  • Smokey BBQ Chicken with Mash & Greens

  • Korean Beef Bowl with Brown Rice

  • Honey Soy Chicken with Asian Greens

Prices start at $49.00 for their Light Started Pack with their Bulk Starter Pack costing $75.00. My Fitness Kitchn currently delivers to Sydney, Blue Mountains, Wollongong, ACT, Newcastle, Central Coast, Bondi and Northern Beaches.
my-foodie-box-meal-kit:
My Foodie Box is a WA based meal kit company focusing on sustainability and high-quality ingredients to provide consumers with all they need to make a healthy fresh meal at home – fuss-free!

My Foodie Box claims to make home cooking easy with their delicious rotating menu catering to several dietary requirements such as vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free choices. Each meal outlines to consumers any dietary considerations including minutes to prepare and skill level to cook! Ingredients are locally sourced in WA steering away from preservative and hormone-free meats and opting for sustainably sourced seafood from suppliers they trust.

My Foodie Box is all about reducing their environmental footprint and a focus for them is ensuring meals arrive fresh and safely in environmentally responsible packaging. They only use packaging that is compostable, recyclable and reusable and they will collect the used box upon delivering customers’ new boxes.

At the time of writing this (Feb 2022) My Foodie Box offers a ‘classic box’ feeding 2-people or 4-people supplying 3, 4 or 5 meals a week starting from $ 12.49 per portion, a ‘family box’ feeding 4-people supplying 3, 4 or 5 meals a week starting from $ 10.00 per portion, a ‘vegan box’ 2-people or 4-people supplying 3 or 4 meals a week starting from $ 11.49 per portion and a ‘mystery box’ feeding 2-people or 4-people supplying 4 or 5 meals a week starting from $ 12.49 per portion.

Nutrition Rundown 

My Foodie Box meals are centred around providing consumers with freshly and locally sourced ingredients whilst promoting sustainable eating practices. Ingredients are high-quality ingredients and there is plenty of variety throughout their menu creating more options for consumers. Consumers can also filter their menu based on dietary requirements and select meals based on their protein preferences including vegan options.

The menu is updated regularly based on seasonality to keep things fresh and each recipe contains a quality source of protein, a serving of fresh vegetables and a carbohydrate source such as whole grains, potatoes, rice etc.

TIP: If you’re looking to add more flavour to meals without adding extra calories add a squeeze of fresh lemon or lime or some herbs and spices! These can often elevate meals with natural punchy flavours.

my-muscle-chef-keto-friendly-pack:

Examples of keto-friendly meals on this plan include:

workout-meals-keto:

ww-weight-watchers-points-program:
WW Points Program

WW (The New Weight Watchers) is Australia’s #1 weight loss and healthy lifestyle program.

WW has recently been simplified to one program – Points. The Points program is entirely individualised via the Personal Assessment questionnaire and each plan is specific to the person’s weight-loss goals (as well as budget, favourite foods etc.). 

When you sign up you can choose a level of support and have access to an amazing app. The App allows you to access a database of food, activity, water, sleep and weight trackers, a barcode scanner, recipes, meditations, workouts and a 24/7 Coach chat. 

You can also access the ‘point value’ of foods to support your daily healthy food choices – The point system aims to support healthy food choices that are higher in fibre and protein and lower in sugar and saturated fats.

Check out the WW PersonalPoints Program here. 

WW Healthy Eats

WW Healthy Eats is the Chef and Nutritionist curated ready-made meals, home delivered for convenience. WW members and non-members can choose a meal plan and receive a weekly meal delivery. Meals have been created to help individuals stay on track to reach their weight-loss goals. 

At the time of writing (June 2022) there are 15 meals to choose from with 4 vegetarian options available. There is an option to select a meal plan –  5,7,10 or 14 meals delivered each week. The only major downfall is the limited delivery areas available in Australia.

Nutrition Rundown

The WW Healthy Eats meals use fresh and whole food ingredients with no added additives or preservatives. Meals are high in protein making them healthy and filling. 

Unfortunately, there is limited information on each meal with no Nutrition Information Panel, ingredients, allergens or macronutrients listed on the website. They are only listed on the physical product. For WW members the Point value system is listed on each product. 

The best part about these meals is anyone can order the WW Healthy Eats – you do not need to be a member!

The FUEL’D range includes 30 high-protein meals including new seasonal recipes and takes on classics and Youfoodz favourites. Protein portions range between 30-50g per meal. There are only meat options available in the FUEL’D range with plenty of options available to suit most taste preferences.

The Youfoodz FUEL’D range provides macronutrient, balanced ready-to-eat meals designed to keep you fuller for longer. There are a variety of proteins to choose from and are great for those who are counting macros or have a higher calorie demand. 

The higher protein and larger portions of carbohydrates are a great post-training meal to refuel and replenish. If we were to improve the FUEL’D meal range we would like the ingredient list to prioritise wholefood ingredients and fewer flavour enhancements, colours and thickeners. 

A larger serving of vegetables would also be a plus for extra fibre, nutrients and crunch!  

Our flavour pick (as of March 2022) is the FUEL’D Teriyaki Chicken Fried Rice!

Find out more about the Youfoodz FUEL’D range in our blog post – A Nutritionists Review of Youfoodz – FUEL’D Meals here.
